events.verdict: Siakam (IND) engages and disengages with Dinwiddie (DAL) as Dinwiddie moves to set the pick.

Siakam (IND) legally contests Dinwiddie's (DAL) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released. Dinwiddie is already falling to the floor on his own prior to further marginal body contact occurring.
Hardy's (DAL) right arm is brought outward toward Mathurin's (IND) path and the contact with Mathurin's front/right arm during the drive is marginal.
Siakam (IND) and Hardy (DAL) engage and disengage with one another as Hardy moves to set the pick.
Siakam (IND) is drawn into the air on the pump fake toward Christie (DAL) and is not in a legal guarding position when body contact occurs during Christie's shooting motion.
Dinwiddie (DAL) initiates contact with Mathurin's (IND) front and left arm that affects his SQBR at the end of the drive.
Sheppard (IND) grasps and then quickly releases Hardy's (DAL) jersey during the inbound.
Sheppard (IND) is collapsing his right arm toward his front when marginal contact occurs with Hardy's (DAL) extended off-arm.
Nesmith (IND) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Hardy (DAL) as simultaneous marginal contact occurs with Hardy's side.
Mathurin (IND) initiates contact across Washington's (DAL) front and affects his SQBR.
Washington (DAL) jumps from point A to point B and initiates contact that affects Mathurin's (IND) driving shot attempt.
Nesmith (IND) brings his right hand toward Washington's (DAL) front and marginal contact occurs as Washington starts his drive.

Replay review of the foul called on Mathurin (IND) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Mathurin initiates contact across Washington's (DAL) left forearm and affects his driving shot attempt.
Christie (DAL) commits a take foul on Nembhard (IND). The transition take foul rule does not apply to the last two minutes of either the fourth quarter or overtime.

Nesmith (IND) makes initial contact with the ball prior to further marginal contact occurring with Christie's (DAL) upper body. Separately, Nesmith's contact with the ball occurs prior to when his left foot lands out of bounds.
Siakam (IND) makes contact with the ball and rips it away from Christie (DAL) as simultaneous marginal contact occurs with Christie's upper body.
Marshall (DAL) is moving ahead of and alongside Mathurin's (IND) path, and absorbs the marginal body contact that occurs as Mathurin cuts back into him at the end of the drive.
Hardy (DAL) extends his arm backward and initiates illegal contact with Nesmith's (IND) head/face.
Marshall (DAL) brings his hands toward Sheppard's (IND) back and marginal contact occurs as Sheppard makes the pass.
Christie (DAL) commits a take foul on Nembhard (IND).
Nesmith (IND) commits a take foul on Hardy (DAL).
Hardy (DAL) grasps and then quickly releases Nesmith's (IND) jersey during the inbound.
Hardy (DAL) commits a take foul on Nesmith (IND).
Mathurin (IND) legally contests Washington's (DAL) jump shot attempt.
Nesmith (IND) avoids stepping out of bounds along the baseline.
